name: 🌱 Digital Agriculture AI Agent - FULL DEMO

parameters.text:
=Analyze this agricultural dataset and act as a Senior Agricultural Intelligence Agent.

DATA:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.analysis) }}

Your job is to:
1. Detect critical agricultural risks.
2. Identify priority farms.
3. Recommend irrigation/inspection actions.
4. Identify water efficiency opportunities.
5. Produce an executive management decision.
6. Decide whether an urgent email alert is required.

IMPORTANT:
- Use ONLY the supplied data.
- Never invent measurements.
- Do not claim that irrigation physically happened.
- This is decision support, not physical execution.

Return ONLY valid JSON with this exact structure:
{
  "executive_status": "CRITICAL",
  "critical_alert": true,
  "headline": "short headline",
  "summary": "executive summary",
  "priority_farms": [
    {
      "farm": "farm name",
      "priority": "HIGH",
      "reason": "reason",
      "action": "recommended action"
    }
  ],
  "recommendations": [
    "recommendation 1",
    "recommendation 2",
    "recommendation 3"
  ],
  "water_efficiency_note": "water recommendation",
  "email_message": "short manager message"
}

options.systemMessage: You are an agricultural AI decision-support agent. Be precise, analytical and conservative. Never invent facts.

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $input.first().json; const a = d.analysis; const ai = d.ai; const escape = v => String(v ?? '') .replace(/&/g, '&') .replace(//g, '>') .replace(/"/g, '"'); const status = escape(ai.executive_status || 'ATTENTION'); const critical = Boolean(ai.critical_alert); const statusColor = critical ? '#dc2626' : '#16a34a'; const statusBg = critical ? '#fef2f2' : '#f0fdf4'; const farmRows = (ai.priority_farms || []).map(f => ` ${escape(f.farm)} ${escape(f.priority)} ${escape(f.reason)} ${escape(f.action)} `).join(''); const recommendations = (ai.recommendations || []) .map(x => `
  • ${escape(x)}
    • `) .join(''); const html = `
    DIGITAL AGRICULTURE

    🌱 AI Farm Intelligence

    Excel → Analytics → AI Agent → Decision → Automation
    EXECUTIVE STATUS
    ${status}
    ${escape(ai.headline)}

    ${escape(ai.summary)}

    📊 Executive KPIs

    RECORDS
    ${a.total_records}    		 FARMS
    ${a.total_farms}    		 HIGH RISK
    ${a.high_risk_events}    		 IRRIGATION
    ${a.irrigation_events}
    SOIL
    ${a.average_soil_moisture}%    		 LEAF HEALTH
    ${a.average_leaf_health}%    		 WATER
    ${Number(a.total_water_liters).toLocaleString()} L    		 ENERGY
    ${a.total_energy_kwh} kWh

    🚨 AI Priority Farms

    ${farmRows}
    Farm Priority Reason Action

    🎯 AI Recommendations

      ${recommendations}
    💧 Water Efficiency

    ${escape(ai.water_efficiency_note)}

    🤖 AI Agent Decision

    ${escape(ai.email_message)}

    Automated by n8n • Digital Agriculture AI Demo
    `; return [{ json: { ...d, email_subject: critical ? `🚨 CRITICAL FARM ALERT | ${ai.headline}` : `📊 FARM AI REPORT | ${ai.headline}`, email_html: html } }];

const d = $input.first().json; const a = d.analysis; const ai = d.ai; const html = `

  • Total farms: ${a.total_farms}

  • Average soil moisture: ${a.average_soil_moisture}%
  • Average leaf health: ${a.average_leaf_health}%
  • Total water: ${a.total_water_liters} L

🎯 Recommendations

    ${(ai.recommendations || []).map(x => `
  • ${x}
    • `).join('')}
`; return [{ json: { ...d, email_subject: `📊 Farm AI Management Report | ${ai.headline || 'Analysis'}`, email_html: html } }];
